summary: Round 6. Only baselines/review.txt:36 changed since round 5; the rest of the staged diff hashes to 28ac1467c7f9, byte-identical to the tree round 3 passed, so 'THE CODE HAS NOT MOVED SINCE ROUND 3' is true and in fact understates it (nothing at all but this line has moved). Every factual claim in the rewritten clause checks out against .harness/review: round 4 (f0ac700d5198, reviewer, changes-requested, M4.47-R4a) found the 'every round found a code defect, none prose' draft false; round 5 (b288318dc038, test-reviewer, changes-requested, M4.47-R5a) found the 'ONLY ROUND 1 WAS CHANGES-REQUESTED' correction false because round 4's own verdict was a second one. Rounds 2 (cf0286e7b8e7) and 3 (28ac1467c7f9) are pass from both roles with minors only, exactly as the entry says; round 1 (e60bf990cb5e) is changes-requested with one blocking (M4.47-R1a) plus minors including the stale javadoc, exactly as the entry says. Declining the count is honest, not evasive: the entry still discloses that rounds 4 and 5 each caught this line asserting something false, which is the load-bearing content of a changes-requested verdict, states the categories for rounds 1-3, states that the enumerable form was falsified twice by the verdict on the draft stating it, and names .harness/review as authoritative -- an auditor is pointed at the record rather than steered away from it, and nothing omitted runs in the author's favour. The substantive claims are unchanged and consistent with the new clause: 63,081 link violations from the production half alone and 'checkLink alone fixes no I2' sit ahead of it and are untouched. One minor on a residue the rewrite left behind.

findings.finding: The two sentences 'Round 4 reviewed this line and found the sentence above false. Round 5 reviews its correction.' are residue from the drafts that were just deleted. (a) The referent no longer exists: the sentence round 4 falsified ('EVERY ROUND FOUND A REAL DEFECT IN CODE, none in prose') was removed at round 5 and its replacement was removed at round 6, so 'the sentence above' now resolves to the nearest preceding sentence, the recoverChainEnd clause -- which round 4 never touched (M4.47-R4a's closing words are 'Everything else in the line I re-measured and it is accurate to the digit'). (b) Both sentences are now strictly redundant: the new clause four sentences earlier states what round 4 caught and what round 5 caught, more precisely and with the mechanism. (c) 'Round 5 reviews its correction' is present tense about a correction that no longer exists in the entry. None of this is false in a way an auditor can be misled about the record -- the correct account is in the same paragraph -- which is why it is minor and not major.
findings.failure_scenario: A maintainer auditing round counts reads the entry top to bottom, reaches 'Round 4 reviewed this line and found the sentence above false', looks up one sentence, and reads it as though round 4 had falsified the recoverChainEnd measurement -- a claim about production behaviour that round 4 explicitly re-measured and confirmed. They then distrust the recoverChainEnd finding, which is the one round-2 minor that overturned the author's reading of a real method. Recommended disposition is to LAND AS IS: review.md's minors-land says a pass carrying minors lands, this entry's own history is three rounds spent rewriting the sentence that describes the rounds, and any edit here creates a round 7 whose surface is the prose the edit adds. If it is ever touched -- in a later commit, not this one -- delete the two sentences rather than rewrite them, per M4.13f's remedy of fewer copies.
